### MediaGenerationInput

```ts
type MediaGenerationInput = Readonly<{
  destination: Readonly<{
    path: string;
  }>;
  settings: MediaGenerationSelection;
}>;
```

The Media owner decides Team, Installation, Release, Grant and Computer
authority before issuing this handle. The App contributes only generation
settings and selected destination/references. The IDs in those selections are
not authority: the host revalidates every one against its current admitted
Computer scope when it accepts a generation.

The owner intentionally returns completed metadata. Operation state, provider
identifiers and billing records remain owner facts. The exposed request
reference identifies a replay; it grants no authority.

```ts
        | "plain"
        | "pencil"
        | "manga"
        | "riso"
        | "halftone"
        | "blueprint"
        | "crt"
        | "watercolor";
    }
  >;
  sessionOperations: $Array<
    Literals<readonly ["agent.read", "agent.send", "agent.manage"]>
  >;
}>;
```

Validates the wire shape of an Agent record: its id, display name, avatar, and
which session operations (read, send, manage) this App may perform on it. Every
Agent has an avatar: the one its owner chose, else Sprite's
`seededAvatar(agentId)`. Conversations carry none of their own.

### messageAuthor()

```ts
function messageAuthor(meta):
  | {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      kind?: "agent";
    }
  | undefined;
```

The author a message's metadata names; none for anything else.

| Parameter | Type                                                   |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `meta`    | [`MessageMetaValue`](#messagemetavalue) \| `undefined` |

#### Returns

##### Type Literal

```ts
{
  id: string;
  name: string;
  kind?: "agent";
}
```

| Name    | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `name`  | `string`  | -                                                                                                                                                                         |

### messageDelegationReply()

```ts
function messageDelegationReply(meta):
```

The authenticated delegation reply a message's metadata carries; none for any

```ts
{
  agentId: string;
  sessionId: string;
  commandId: string;
  outcome: "completed" | "failed" | "interrupted" | "cancelled" | "outcome_unknown";
  diagnostic?: string;
  waitingOnYou?: object[];
}
```

| Name            | Type                                                                                   | Default value | Description                                                              |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `agentId`       | `string`                                                                               | `identifier`  | -                                                                        |
| `sessionId`     | `string`                                                                               | `identifier`  | -                                                                        |
| `commandId`     | `string`                                                                               | `identifier`  | -                                                                        |
| `outcome`       | `"completed"` \| `"failed"` \| `"interrupted"` \| `"cancelled"` \| `"outcome_unknown"` | -             | The exact settlement outcome; failures are never collapsed.              |
| `diagnostic?`   | `string`                                                                               | -             | Bounded, single-line terminal diagnostic for work that did not complete. |
| `waitingOnYou?` | `object`[]                                                                             | -             | Open items of the replying Session that now wait on the recipient.       |

`undefined`

### registerCatalog()

```ts
function registerCatalog(commands, catalog): Disposer;
```

Register one App's Whistle catalog with its host. An App defines each command
once, contributes the same catalog to its own composer runtime for slash
commands, and registers it here so the shell projects it into the palette,
menus, keys and the agent view. Availability is read once at registration;
register again to publish a change.

### statusActionAllowed()


Whether an action names something the App declares now: an enabled item, and for
a menu exactly one enabled option. Every hop that delivers an action applies
this rule against its own latest copy of the items.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                         |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `items`   | readonly [`AppStatusItem`](#appstatusitem)[] |
| `action`  | [`AppStatusAction`](#appstatusaction)        |

#### Returns

`boolean`

### navigationActivationAllowed()

```ts
function navigationActivationAllowed(state, activation): boolean;
```

Whether an activation names something the App published now: a crumb (and its
sibling), or an enabled command. Every hop applies this rule against its own
latest copy of the report, so a stale shell cannot reach the App.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                  |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `state`      | [`AppNavigationState`](#appnavigationstate)           |
| `activation` | [`AppNavigationActivation`](#appnavigationactivation) |

#### Returns

`boolean`
